subtitle: A journey through the Four Worlds
preview: Explore the Four Worlds, buy Places, embellish them and build your adventure.
footer: Four worlds, thirty-two spaces and a different game every time.

a1.title: Meadow Festival
a1.text: The Meadow is celebrating! The stalls are busy and business is good: collect 45 coins, the same coins Grugnetto gathers on every level.

a2.title: Squirrel Shortcut
a2.text: A squirrel points out a hidden trail, the same one Grugnetto follows through the Squirrel Forest. Head to the next Portal.

a3.title: Oasis Ahead
a3.text: You find a cool oasis, just like the ones in the Golden Dunes. Catch your breath, collect 20 coins and move forward 1 space.

a4.title: Builder’s Kit
a4.text: A crate contains everything you need for a quick job — even a tool that looks suspiciously like a super-jump booster. Add one free Embellishment to one of your Places; if you cannot, sell the kit for 20 coins.

a5.title: The Grand Portal
a5.text: The Grand Portal lights up ahead, a golden heart pulsing at its center. Go there at once.

a6.title: Four Worlds Festival
a6.text: All Four Worlds are celebrating together, one big chain of festivities. Collect 6 coins for every Place you own.

a7.title: Hidden Treasure
a7.text: Beneath some old boards you find a chest full of the same golden coins Grugnetto collects across his worlds. Collect 55 coins.

a8.title: The Road Home
a8.text: A glowing trail, like the arc of a perfect jump, shows you the way. Return to Grugnetto’s Home.

i1.title: Downpour!
i1.text: A downpour ruins some of your supplies — only the frogs at the Pond seem happy about it. Spend 40 coins to get moving again.

i2.title: Hungry Squirrels
i2.text: The squirrels have raided the stores, leaving only picked-clean acorns behind. Spend 6 coins for every Place you own; if you own none, spend 15.

i3.title: Sandstorm
i3.text: Sand covers the trail, and even the Dune mice take shelter. Move back 3 spaces.

i4.title: Blocked Passage
i4.text: A collapse blocks the way in a cloud of mine dust. Return to Base Camp.

i5.title: Fussy Portal
i5.text: The Portal refuses to cooperate: its flag hangs still, without a spark of magic. Spend 20 coins to fix it, then travel to the next Portal.

i6.title: Maintenance Day
i6.text: Time for inspections, with tools as sharp as the Mine's saws. Spend 8 coins for every Embellishment you own; if you have none, spend 15.

i7.title: Road Closed
i7.text: The trail is closed. Take a detour to the Picnic Spot, where a juicy apple is waiting for you.

i8.title: Small Breakdown
i8.text: A small breakdown damages one of your Embellishments — you'd need the right key from Grugnetto's Workshop. Remove one; if you have none, spend 25 coins.
